Machine Learning Guide
Introduction to Machine Learning Machine Learning (ML) is a subset of Artificial Intelligence
(AI) that enables computers to learn from data and improve performance over time without being
explicitly programmed. It involves algorithms that identify patterns in data and make
predictions or decisions.
Learning Paradigms Supervised Learning - Uses labeled data to learn a mapping from inputs to

outputs (e.g., predicting house prices). Unsupervised Learning - Discovers hidden structures in
unlabeled data (e.g., clustering customers). Reinforcement Learning - Trains an agent to take
actions in an environment to maximize cumulative reward.
Common Machine Learning Algorithms Linear Regression - Predicts continuous values. Logistic
Regression - Binary classification. Decision Trees - Rule-based splits on features. Random

Forest - Ensemble of trees for robust predictions. Support Vector Machines (SVM) - Finds
optimal separating hyperplane. k-Nearest Neighbors (kNN) - Classifies based on nearby points.
Naive Bayes - Probabilistic classifier with independence assumption. Gradient Boosting
(XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) - Powerful ensembles. K-Means Clustering - Partitions data into K
clusters. DBSCAN - Density-based clustering. PCA - Dimensionality reduction.

Evaluation Metrics Regression: MAE, RMSE, R^2. Classification: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1,
ROC-AUC. Clustering: Silhouette Score, Davies Bouldin Index.
Feature Engineering Handling missing values, encoding categoricals, scaling, feature selection,
and domain-specific transformations.
Model Serving Batch predictions, real-time inference APIs, monitoring drift, and retraining
schedules.

Vector Databases & RAG
Overview Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines a vector search system with a generative
model so answers are grounded in a knowledge base.
Embeddings Sentence transformers (e.g., all-MiniLM-L6-v2) convert text to dense vectors.
Similarity search finds relevant chunks.
Vector Stores Chroma - Local, simple persist directory. FAISS - Facebook AI Similarity Search
in-memory or on-disk indexes. Milvus/Weaviate - Scalable, server-based vector DBs.

Chunking & Metadata Split long docs into overlapping chunks (e.g., 800 1200 chars, 10 15%
overlap). Store filename, page, and section headers as metadata to improve traceability.
Prompt T emplate (RAG) System: You must ONLY answer using the provided context. If missing, say
you cannot find it. User: Context: [chunks] Question: [user question]
Failure Modes Hallucination if the model ignores context, poor chunking, or weak retrieval.

Mitigations: temperature 0.2, strict system prompt, show sources, and fallback when retrieval
is empty.

Company Handbook (Excerpt)
Work Hours & Attendance Core hours are 10:00 16:00 with flexible start between 8:00 10:00.
Remote work allowed up to 3 days/week.
Leave Policy Annual leave: 20 working days. Sick leave requires a medical note for absences of
2+ consecutive days.
Security & Data Handling All customer data is confidential. Never share API keys or
credentials. Use least-privilege access.
Expense Policy Travel requires prior approval. Submit receipts within 10 days. Per-diem rates

vary by region.
Code of Conduct Be respectful, inclusive, and professional. No harassment or discrimination.
Adhere to local laws.

Product FAQ (WidgetPro)
What is WidgetPro? WidgetPro is a modular analytics dashboard for SMBs.
Key Features  Real-time KPI tiles  Custom reports  T eam-based permissions  CSV/Excel export
Pricing Starter: 19/monthGrowth : 49/month Scale: Contact sales
Limits Starter: 3 dashboards, Growth: 10 dashboards, Scale: unlimited. API rate limit: 600
requests/min per org.
Support Email: support@widgetpro.example SLA: Starter (best effort), Growth (8x5), Scale
(24x7).

API Reference (Subset)
Authentication Use a bearer token via the Authorization header. T okens expire in 24 hours.
Endpoints GET /v1/health - returns service status. POST /v1/reports - creates a report job
(asynchronous). GET /v1/reports/{id} - returns job status and result URL when complete.
Error Codes 400 Bad Request - invalid input. 401 Unauthorized - missing/expired token. 404 Not
Found - resource doesn't exist. 429 T oo Many Requests - backoff and retry with exponential
strategy. 5xx - transient errors; retry with jitter.

Data Governance
PII Handling Encrypt at rest and in transit. Redact PII in logs. Access only on a need-to-know
basis.
Retention Application logs: 30 days rolling. Backups: 35 days. Customer deletes honored within
14 days.
Auditing All admin actions are logged with timestamps, user IDs, and IP addresses. Quarterly
audit reviews are mandated.

Onboarding Checklist
Week 1  Laptop provisioning and SSO setup  Meet your mentor and team  Read the Company
Handbook excerpt  Access dev environments
Week 2  Pair-programming sessions  First small task shipped  Intro to monitoring and on-call
Week 3  Ownership of a small feature  Write a post-merge summary  Schedule feedback session

Incident Response Playbook
Severities SEV1 - Critical outage, customer impact. SEV2 - Major degradation or partial outage.
SEV3 - Minor incident or bug impacting a subset of users.
Process 1. Triage and assign incident commander. 2. Communicate status every 15 30 minutes. 3.
Mitigate, then identify root cause. 4. Create & assign action items. 5. Publish postmortem
within 5 business days.

Analytics Concepts
KPIs North Star Metric, Activation Rate, Retention (D1/D7/D30), Churn, LTV, CAC.
Cohorts Group users by signup month to track retention and revenue trends.
Attribution First-touch vs last-touch vs data-driven models. Beware of channel cannibalization
and seasonality.

Glossary
A/B T est - Experiment comparing a control vs a variant. Backoff - Increasing wait times between
retries. Drift - Model performance change when data distribution shifts. Embeddings - Vector
representations of text for similarity search. Grounding - Restricting model answers to
provided evidence. Silhouette Score - Cluster separation metric (-1 to 1). Higher is better.
Vector Store - Database optimized for vector similarity queries.
